name: slider
title: Slider
summary: A fader on a ruler: a hairline track filled in ink up to an accent pointer, with ticks below.
use: For a value on a continuous or finely stepped range: volume, exposure, opacity, tempo.
anatomy: Ruler: minor ticks, major ticks with optional numbers

options.name: ticks
options.description: Ticks on the ruler; every fifth is major.

options.name: centered
options.description: Fill from the middle, for ranges around zero such as exposure.

options.name: defaultValue
options.description: Double-clicking the track or the label puts the value back.

options.name: editable
options.description: Double-clicking the reading lets people type an exact value.

options.name: onEditingChanged
options.description: Called when a drag, reset or typed edit starts and ends, so a whole gesture is one undo step.

rules: The pointer is the only accent; the fill is ink.
Clicking anywhere on the track moves the pointer there.
A gesture that changes the value is one undo step: begin on the first change, commit when it ends.
The track is an inset groove filled with ink; the pointer is a raised fader cap carrying the accent line.
accessibility: Exposed as a slider with its written value; arrow, Page and Home/End keys work.
